subject: maths
question: In an election between two candidates, 80% of the registered voters cast their vote and 19% of the votes polled were found invalid. The winning candidate got 70% of the valid votes and won the election by a margin of 1458 votes. How many voters were registered?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the total number of registered voters be V.

Using successive percentage: Margin = V × Polled% × Valid% × Margin%

⇒ 1458 = V × 80% × (100 − 19)% × (70 − 30)%

⇒ 1458 = V × (4/5) × (81/100) × (2/5)

⇒ V = 1458 × (5/4) × (100/81) × (5/2) = 5625

**∴ The correct answer is 5625 voters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Votes polled = 80% of registered voters

Invalid votes = 19% of polled votes

Winner gets 70% of valid votes

Winning margin = 1458 votes
